reading: A one-workgroup dispatch (896-element BinaryVecF16, FastRmsNormF16, CopyGeneralF16) costs ~29-31 us of GPU time plus a ~17-21 us gap before the next dispatch: ~50 us of wall per dispatch that no kernel shape removes. It is not barrier cost: receipts/2026-09-09-native-nobarrier-verified (HK_PERFTEST=nobarrier, every pipeline barrier skipped in hk_cmd_buffer.c) moved decode by under 0.3%, and receipts/2026-09-08-gated-barrier-screen (MLX_OMARCHY_GATED_BARRIERS=1) by nothing measurable. It is not host descriptor/pipeline-bind cost: the profiler's host record time per dispatch is 1.6 us p50 (4bit-analysis.txt). What remains is the device's per-kernel launch and drain on Honeykrisp/AGX, so the only lever is fewer dispatches. A submission boundary inside the token costs a further ~210-240 us; the candidate's 345 nodes cross kBatchNodeBudget (256) once per token, so a 512 budget would remove one boundary (~0.2 ms, ~1.5% of a 13 ms token). Not changed here: extends buffer lifetimes and watchdog exposure for prefill batches; measure it on its own if the 1.5% is wanted.
